disclosure: Post hoc protocol amendment prompted by the locked Candidate V9 result and a subsequent treatment-sequencing audit. The Candidate V10 population and estimator are locked before any Candidate V10 treatment-effect estimate is computed.

candidate_v10_population.eligibility: Verified HR-positive/HER2-negative day-180 landmark survivors with no documented chemotherapy initiation by day 180 and ascertainable chemotherapy start timing.
candidate_v10_population.selection_rule: Include patients with no chemotherapy-classified treatment records, or patients for whom every chemotherapy-classified record has a valid nonnegative start day and all valid chemotherapy start days are greater than 180. Exclude any patient with a chemotherapy-classified record having a missing, negative, or implausible start day, and exclude any patient with chemotherapy initiated on or before day 180.
candidate_v10_population.future_treatment_rule: Chemotherapy initiated after day 180 does not exclude a patient. No restriction uses whether chemotherapy was ever received after the landmark.
candidate_v10_population.treatment_contrast: Hormone therapy initiation during days 0-180 versus no initiation by day 180.
candidate_v10_population.estimand: ATO difference in 730-day post-landmark restricted mean survival time, initiation minus no initiation.

estimator.propensity: Exact locked Candidate V9 cross-fitted Stage 30 regularized propensity specification.
estimator.censoring: Exact locked Candidate V9 cross-fitted discrete-time regularized logistic censoring model.
estimator.outcome: Exact locked Candidate V9 cross-fitted arm-specific ridge model on the IPCW-RMST pseudo-outcome, bounded to [0,730] days.
estimator.aggregation: Exact locked Candidate V9 patient-level repeated-score aggregation over 20 nuisance partitions.
